youtube.title: Why Every Pen Cap Has a Hole (It Saves Lives)
youtube.description: Why does almost every pen cap have a hole in it? Not for the ink. The hole is there so that if a child swallows a cap, a little air can still get through. It is described in ISO 11540, a voluntary international safety standard that many makers follow. The tiny hole in the pen's barrel handles the ink; the cap's hole does a very different job. Here is the real story, myth versus truth. The Hidden Why: the real reason behind things you use every day. #TheHiddenWhy #facts #explained
